an7.21:1.2: ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā vesāliyaṃ viharati sārandade cetiye.
an7.21:1.3: atha kho sambahulā licchavī yena bhagavā tenupasaṅkamiṃsu. upasaṅkamitvā bhagavantaṃ abhivādetvā ekamantaṃ nisīdiṃsu. ekamantaṃ nisinne kho te licchavi bhagavā etadavoca:
an7.21:1.4: satta vo licchavī, aparihāniye dhamme desessāmi.
an7.21:1.5: taṃ suṇātha, sādhukaṃ manasi karotha, bhāsissāmīti.
an7.21:1.6: evambhanteti kho te licchavī bhagavato paccassosuṃ.
an7.21:2.1: katame ca licchavī satta aparihānīyā dhammā: (1)
an7.21:2.2: yāvakīvañca licchavī, vajjī abhiṇhaṃ sannipātā bhavissanti sannipātabahulā,
an7.21:2.3: vuddhiyeva licchavī, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (2)
an7.21:3.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī, vajjī samaggā sannipatissantī, samaggā vuṭṭhahissanti, samaggā vajjikaraṇīyāni karissanti
an7.21:3.2: vuddhiyeva licchavī vajjīnaṃ pāṭikkhā no parihāni. (3)
an7.21:4.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī, vajjī apaññattaṃ na paññāpessanti, paññattaṃ na samucchindissanti, yathā paññatte porāṇe vajjidhamme samādāya vattissanti,
an7.21:4.2: vuddhiyeva licchavī vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (4)
an7.21:5.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī, vajjī ye te vajjīnaṃ vajjimahallakā, te sakkarissanti, garukarissanti, mānessanti, pūjessanti, tesañca sotabbaṃ maññissanti,
an7.21:5.2: vuddhiyeva licchavī, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (5)
an7.21:6.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī, vajjī yā tā kulitthiyo kulakumāriyo, tā na okassa pasayha vāsessanti,
an7.21:6.2: vuddhiyeva licchavī, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (6)
an7.21:7.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī, vajjī yāni tāni vajjīnaṃ vajjicetiyāni abbhantarāni ceva bāhirāni ca, tāni sakkarissanti, garukarissanti, mānessanti. pūjessanti, tesañca dinnapubbaṃ katapubbaṃ dhammikaṃ baliṃ no parihāpessanti,
an7.21:7.2: vuddhiyeva licchavī, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni. (7)
an7.21:8.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī, vajjīnaṃ arahantesu dhammikā rakkhāvaraṇaguttī susaṃvihitā bhavissati
an7.21:8.2: ‘kinti anāgatā ca arahanto vijitaṃ āgaccheyyuṃ, āgatā ca arahanto vijite phāsuṃ vihareyyunti’
an7.21:8.3: vuddhiyeva licchavī, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihāni.
an7.21:9.1: yāvakīvañca licchavī, ime satta aparihānīyā dhammā vajjīsu ṭhassanti, imesu ca sattasu aparihānīyesu dhammesu vajjī sandissanti,
an7.21:9.2: vuddhiyeva licchavī, vajjīnaṃ pāṭikaṅkhā no parihānīti.
